models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.best: The hardest work: long autonomous agent runs, science, deep analysis. Slow and pricey.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.best: Anthropic's recommended default. Coding (it powers Claude Code), long tasks, documents.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.best: Fast and smart: writing, bug fixes, polished docs, slides and spreadsheets, high-volume apps.
models.note: New 28 Sep: 30% faster than Sonnet 5, same price.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.best: Simple tasks at scale: classification, extraction, routing, chatbots. The cheapest Claude.
models.note: New 7 Oct: replaces Haiku 4.5 at a tenth of the price. Prompts longer than 100K tokens cost 5x more ($0.50 / $2.50).

models.name: Claude Mythos 5.1
models.best: Same model as Fable 5.1 with different safeguards, for cyber defense and life sciences. Vetted orgs only.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.best: OpenAI's strongest: coding, computer and browser use, science, professional work.
models.note: 'Astra Pro' is the same model with reasoning mode set to pro: thinks longer, better on hard tasks.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.best: Strong reasoning for complex professional work at a mid-tier price.
models.note: In ChatGPT on Plus and up. 'Sol Pro' = same model, pro reasoning mode.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.best: Extremely cheap. Routine tasks and huge volumes.
models.note: The model free ChatGPT users get. 'Luna Pro' = same model, pro reasoning mode.

models.name: GPT Image 2.5
models.best: Image generation and editing in ChatGPT, including sketch-to-image.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.best: Google's new flagship: deep work in coding, finance, law, security and science. Ranked #1 on the Vals Index at launch.
models.note: New 13 Oct. Launch price until 30 Nov 2026, then $4 / $20. In the Gemini app with Google AI Pro or Ultra.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.best: Still a preview, and now replaced by Gemini 4 Argon as Google's flagship. Pick Argon for new work.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.best: Smartest Flash yet: coding, agents, workflows. Great price/performance.
models.note: Launch price until 31 Dec 2026. From 1 Jan 2027 it doubles to $1.50 / $7.50.

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
models.best: Cheap and fast Gemini for bulk work. The older 3.1 Flash-Lite costs even less ($0.25 / $1.50).

models.name: Nano Banana 2.1
models.best: Image generation and photo editing. Pro does 4K and crisp in-image text.
models.note: Price depends on size: about $0.03 (1K), $0.05 (2K) or $0.11 (4K) per image.

models.name: Veo 3.1
models.best: Cinematic video with synced audio.

models.name: Gemini Omni Flash
models.best: Fast conversational video generation and editing.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Live
models.best: Real-time voice conversation and voice agents.

models.name: Lyria 3.5
models.best: Full songs with verse/chorus structure.

models.name: Qwen3.8 (2.4T / 27B)
models.best: Alibaba's free-to-download line. The big 2.4T model needs a server with many graphics cards; the 27B version fits one strong workstation.
models.note: Qwen3.8 Max, the version in Alibaba's own app, is not downloadable.

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.best: Strongest open-weight model for coding. At about 753B parameters it needs a server with several graphics cards.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4.1 Flash
models.best: Near-frontier quality you can download. Even the newer V4.1 Flash (about 763B parameters) needs a server with several graphics cards.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.best: Strong all-rounder, good for agents.

models.name: Mistral Small 4
models.best: European, Apache-2.0, 256K context. Easy on a company server.
